learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn the rules for using the articles 'A', 'An', and 'The' correctly before nouns.]
warm_up_hook: 🎩 'A', 'An', and 'The' are three tiny magic words we use every single day. They act like little arrows pointing at nouns. Let's learn the secret rules of when to use which pointer!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'An' before a singular noun that begins with a vowel SOUND. Remember our five vowels? A, E, I, O, U!
We use the word 'A' before a singular noun that begins with a consonant sound. Consonants are all the other letters in the alphabet (B, C, D, F, G, etc.).
We use 'The' when we talk about a SPECIFIC or special thing, or when there is only ONE of it in the whole world. We also use 'The' if we talk about the same noun a second time.
examples_or_templates: I saw a cat. [The] cat was sleeping. (Talking about it the second time)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which article fits in the blank? I ate ____ orange for breakfast.
❓ Which article is correct here? Look at ____ moon!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in 'A' or 'An': 1. ____ house  2. ____ ant
subjective_practice.hint: Look at the first letter. Is it a vowel or a consonant?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blanks with A, An, or The: 'I bought ____ new book. ____ book is very interesting.'
subjective_practice.hint: Use 'A/An' for the first time you mention the book, and 'The' when you talk about it again!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Spot the mistake and correct it: 'Rohan is a best boy in class.'
subjective_practice.hint: When we talk about something special like 'the best', we use the special article.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🔍 Article Detective Hunt
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Open an English newspaper or your storybook. Set a timer for 1 minute. Count how many times you can spot the word 'The'. Try to find 5 words with 'A' and 3 words with 'An'!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Use 'An' before words starting with vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u).
⭐ Use 'A' before words starting with consonant sounds.
⭐ Use 'The' for specific things, unique things (like the sun), or things already mentioned.
